title: Lab - Namespaces
description: Create namespaces, run workloads in them and reach across the boundary.
scenario: Create namespaces, run workloads in them and reach across the boundary. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Create and use
tasks.instructions: Create namespace dev and run a Pod in it without the -n flag.
tasks.solution:
kubectl create ns dev
kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=dev
kubectl run web --image=nginx

tasks.title: Task 2 - Cross-namespace DNS
tasks.instructions: From a Pod in default, resolve a Service called api in namespace dev.
tasks.solution: kubectl run t --rm -it --image=busybox -n default -- nslookup api.dev.svc.cluster.local

tasks.title: Task 3 - Count
tasks.instructions: Count the Pods in every namespace with one command.
